answer: Every identity carries a shortable fraud-futures contract. Its sponsor locks $500 long; any challenger can stake $500 short that it is fake. A public beacon draws 5% of identities each epoch for a deep audit by five rotating auditors in 48 hours. Challenger stakes flow into one river pool paying fraud proofs, and one sponsor's identities share a garden plot, so one proof burns every sibling contract in it. 100 clones put $100,000 at risk against one proof; 100 honest agents lose $0, stakes back after 20 epochs. A fake identity is a weed: pull one root and the whole bed comes up.
